title: Roast cauliflower pasta with beans and rosemary crumbs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a plain whole food or basic staple: cauliflower, cavolo nero, dried pasta, tinned beans, breadcrumbs, garlic, oil and lemon.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including cavolo nero, is an everyday item at Tesco or similar.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, a large pan and a frying pan, and uses simple roasting, boiling and frying.

works.reason: One cauliflower, 350g pasta, a tin of beans and 200g cavolo nero suit four, the 2+1+1 tbsp oil split matches the 4 tbsp listed, and the times and temperature are sound.

honest_times.reason: 25 minutes covers the floreting, shredding, slicing, crumb frying and final toss while the pasta boils, and the 25 minute cook time matches the roasting.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, the names match their ids, and lemon is on the December fresh list.

seasonal_feel.reason: A hot roast cauliflower pasta with winter greens and rosemary suits mid-December, and the cauliflower is central to the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are brief, clear British home-cook instructions without restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling family dinner with vegetables, beans and pasta, and enough flavour from the garlic, chilli, lemon and crumbs to cook again.
